rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This App Store Connect MCP server, developed by Trial and Error Inc, provides AI assistants with direct access to iOS app metrics and financial data from Apple's App Store Connect API. Built with TypeScript and featuring JWT-based authentication, automatic pagination handling, and rate limiting, it eliminates the manual export-import cycle that developers face when trying to analyze iOS app performance data with AI tools. The implementation offers access to sales reports, user analytics, app health metrics, beta testing data, and subscription information, making it particularly useful for iOS developers and companies needing regular financial reports, app performance monitoring, or automated competitive analysis without the overhead of building custom API integrations.
